source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted issuer override path clones provider details, applies only present nonempty string values, then assigns usePKCE and useExternalBrowser as Boolean options even when false. The original migration used a single truthy-value loop. Keep these phases separate: copying every option only when truthy would lose false Boolean configuration. The prior provider-default/cloning lesson remains linked; this adds the exact typed-option distinction. No login, invalid-input or mutation test ran.
title: OAuth issuer overrides handle empty strings and Boolean false differently
